newsitem.title: USA: Wells Fargo stock plunges after earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Wells Fargo stock plunges after earnings warning.

text.p: Wells Fargo and Co. stock fell sharply in early trading Wednesday after the big bank said its second-quarter earnings will be well below Wall Street expectations.

Shares of Wells Fargo lost $18 to $261 on the New York Stock Exchange after a brief trading halt, which was prompted by the company's announcement that its earnings per share would be about $1 below analysts' consensus of $3.53, as reported by Zacks Investment Research.

Wells Fargo, the nation's eighth-largest bank, said in a brief statement that the anticipated drop in earnings was due to "operational and back-office issues" related to its acquisition of First Interstate Bancorp last year.
The company, which said the estimate of its results was preliminary, will report its second-quarter earnings next Tuesday, when it will make available more details.
A spokesman was not immediately available to comment.
Wells Fargo completed its $11 billion merger with First Interstate in April 1996.
